exercises.q: Was Tom the one who translated this?
exercises.why: **перевёл** — перевести́ (perfective): to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret; to remit (money). Wiktionary: пере- + вести́.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
